visual_description: Relaxed stone-beige button-up shirt in washed cotton with a point collar, full button placket and a curved shirttail hem.
Black high-waisted trousers with double front pleats, a pressed centre crease and a long wide straight leg.
Olive utility overshirt in heavy cotton twill with two buttoned flap chest pockets and a boxy workwear cut.
Ivory fine-ribbed tank with a scooped neckline, wide shoulder straps and a close fitted body.
Mid-blue straight-leg jeans with faded whiskering, classic five-pocket construction and contrast topstitching.
Camel V-neck cardigan in soft brushed knit with five buttons, ribbed cuffs and hem, cut oversized with dropped shoulders.
Navy single-breasted blazer with notch lapels, one button, flap hip pockets and shaping seams through a tailored body.
Heather-grey pullover hoodie in brushed fleece, plain fronted, with a drawstring hood, kangaroo pocket and ribbed cuffs and hem.
Black smooth faux-leather belt with a matte black roller buckle and a single keeper loop.
Champagne satin midi skirt cut on the bias, falling in a smooth A-line flare with a liquid high-shine surface.
Tobacco-brown suede-look jacket in a short blouson cut with a point collar, full-length zip and slanted welt pockets.
Plain white boxy tee in mid-weight cotton jersey with a ribbed crew neck and dropped shoulders.
Charcoal single-breasted longline coat in marled wool melton with notch lapels, three buttons and slanted welt pockets, falling below the knee.
Khaki cargo mini skirt in washed cotton twill with belt loops and two large buttoned cargo flap pockets on the hips.
Pink cropped sweatshirt in soft brushed fleece with a ribbed crew neck, blouson balloon sleeves and a wide ribbed hem.
Small black shoulder bag in smooth faux leather with a curved baguette body, gold-tone hardware and a short flat shoulder strap.
Light-blue mom jeans in pale washed denim, high-waisted with a roomy tapered leg and classic five-pocket detailing.
Sage green fine-ribbed long-sleeve top with a plain crew neck and a slim stretch fit.
Beige padded gilet in matte nylon with horizontal quilted baffles, a high funnel collar, full zip and slanted welt pockets.
Set of three lilac satin hair scrunchies with a high-shine gathered ring and soft elastic core.
Black high-waisted leggings in matte stretch jersey with a wide waistband and a long kick-flared leg.
Red wrap dress covered in a small cream and tan floral blossom print, with flutter sleeves, a waist tie and a ruffled asymmetric midi hem.
Natural cream canvas tote with two long shoulder handles, an open top and a large unstructured body.
Chocolate-brown faux-leather mini skirt with belt loops, front pockets and a clean A-line cut.
Grey heather wide-leg sweatpants in brushed fleece with an elasticated pull-on waistband and a loose column leg.
Mint green crossbody bag with a diamond-quilted body, a softly curved hobo shape and an adjustable strap on silver clip hooks.
Navy pleated tennis skirt with a smooth high waistband breaking into crisp knife pleats all the way round.
All-white chunky court sneakers on a thick sculpted platform sole, with lace-up fronts and small perforated vents.
All-black retro runner sneakers panelled in suede and mesh, on a chunky lugged rubber sole.
Three pairs of grey marled crew socks in a plain ribbed knit with a reinforced heel and toe; no visible logo or motif on the product image despite the product name.
Forest-green zip-through hoodie in brushed fleece with a drawstring hood, split front pockets and ribbed cuffs and hem.
All-black platform sneakers with a clean unbranded leather upper sitting on a thick flat platform sole.
Bright blue lightweight track jacket in glossy nylon with a stand collar, full zip, raglan sleeves and elasticated cuffs and hem.
Sand cargo joggers in washed cotton twill with a drawstring waist, large flap thigh pockets and elasticated cuffs.
Burgundy six-panel baseball cap in cotton twill with a curved topstitched brim and stitched eyelet vents; no logo or badge on the front.
Cream high-top sneakers in tonal smooth leather with a padded ankle collar, perforated toe vents and a classic cupsole.
Black training shorts in matte technical mesh with an elasticated waistband, side pockets and a loose knee-length leg.
Silver metallic waist bag with a high-shine coated finish, a single top zip and an adjustable black webbing strap with a side-release buckle.
Olive trail sneakers panelled in matte leather and mesh with a reinforced toe cap, heel pull tab and an aggressive deep-lugged black outsole.
Purple cropped windbreaker in glossy crinkled nylon with a stand collar, full zip and elasticated cropped hem and cuffs.
Black ankle boots in smooth faux leather with a pointed toe, a low block heel and a side zip on a clean unadorned upper.
Camel single-breasted wool-blend coat with notch lapels, three buttons, slanted welt pockets and a straight knee-length line.
Emerald satin midi dress with a draped cowl neckline, fine spaghetti straps, a ruched waist and a bias-cut asymmetric hem.
White minimal leather sneakers with a clean unbranded upper, tonal stitching and a slim white cupsole.
Black structured tote in grained faux leather with a squared box body, two rolled top handles and a roomy open interior.
Navy crew-neck sweater in a fine soft wool-blend knit with ribbed neck, cuffs and hem and a clean regular fit.
Ivory pleated wide-leg trousers with a high waist, deep double front pleats and a long pressed column leg.
Dark brown Chelsea boots in grained leather with elastic side gussets, a heel pull tab and a stacked low heel on a welted sole.
Rose-gold tone hoop earrings with a smooth polished tubular profile and a hinged snap closure.
Charcoal tailored suit jacket in marled wool flannel with notch lapels, two buttons, flap hip pockets and a structured shoulder.
Burgundy velvet mini dress with a soft draped cowl neck, fine straps and ruching through a close bodycon body.
Grey technical parka in a matte weatherproof shell with a drawcord hood, zipped chest and sleeve pockets, large flap hip pockets and hook-and-loop cuffs.
Black slim leather belt with edge stitching, a gunmetal pin buckle and a single keeper loop.
Powder-blue scarf in a soft brushed cashmere-feel wool, cut long and wide with twisted fringing at both ends.
Washed grey cargo jeans in faded denim with belt loops, large flap thigh pockets and a straight relaxed leg.
Pink baby tee in fine ribbed jersey with a ribbed crew neck, short sleeves and a cropped fitted body.
Black mini backpack in matte nylon with a curved top zip, a zipped front pocket, side slip pockets and padded adjustable straps.
Cream linen-blend shirt dress with a point collar, full button front, rolled short sleeves and a self-tie waist belt.
White low-profile sneakers in smooth leather with a slim tonal sole, round toe and an unbranded minimal upper.
Navy tailored wide-leg trousers with a high waist, single front pleat, belt loops and a long pressed column leg.
Black crossbody bag in grained faux leather with a clean flap closure, a structured boxy body and a long adjustable strap on matte black clips.
White oversized tee with a black Bauhaus-style geometric chest print of hard-edged squares, rectangles, a filled circle and thin intersecting rules.
Orange oversized tee with a large abstract geometric chest print in charcoal, sand and tan: overlapping triangles, a circle and grid rules in a distressed screen-print texture.
Black oversized hoodie with a large abstract geometric chest print in cream, red and grey: stacked rectangles, arcs and overlapping circles in a worn halftone finish.
